# Agellus Capital — page summaries

Use with /llms.txt. Prefer the live HTML on https://www.agellus.com.

Agellus Capital partners with management teams of essential, non-discretionary services businesses across the United States and Canada. Strategy combines organic growth and buy-and-build add-on acquisitions. Office in Clayton, Missouri.

Focus verticals: business-to-business services, non-discretionary consumer services, and supply chain and infrastructure services. Typical platform size cited on-site: $2 to $25 million of EBITDA; add-ons any size.

Current platforms described on /portfolio include fire and life safety, managed IT, commercial landscaping, and restoration.

Fund I is described on-site as $400 million. Treat performance and fundraising figures as firm-published marketing copy, not independently verified here.

Legal: not an offer to sell securities; see /privacy, /terms, /cookies.
